verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents secure SSH access to instances (key-based auth, run commands, transfer files) and one-click template launches that could include Jupyter environments, which together enable IDE remote-connection workflows (e.g., VS Code Remote-SSH). However, the evidence never explicitly names Jupyter notebook access or a documented one-step VS Code/Cursor connection flow. Missing for 10: explicit Jupyter launch/access docs, explicit VS Code/Cursor remote-connect guide or extension support, and any hands-on confirmation of a true 'one step' connect experience.
